name: Nicole Warren
bio:
Nicole develops confident competitors through purposeful training, communication, and team culture. She brings over five years of coaching experience and a decade of playing club volleyball, plus eight years of beach volleyball.

She competed at the varsity level at Clackamas High School and went on to play collegiately, bringing real competitive experience to every practice and match.

name: Charles Awounor
bio:
Charles brings competitive experience and a development-focused approach to HVVC 16-2. His coaching style centers on building well-rounded athletes — technically sound, mentally tough, and hungry to compete.

He is committed to creating a high-performance environment where every player is pushed to reach their full potential, both in the gym and in competition.

name: Kendal Ishida
bio:
Kendal brings a strong club volleyball background from her time with NCVBC and Athena VC. She currently serves as JV2 Head Coach at Clackamas High School and coaches at GETC, bringing a well-rounded competitive perspective to the 12-1 program.

Kendal is committed to building strong fundamentals, technical skills, and the mental side of being an athlete — creating a positive, supportive environment where players develop their love for the game.

name: Sarah Borski
bio: The 10U program is where it all begins — and Sarah personally leads it to make sure every young athlete gets the best possible foundation, building confident players and a lifelong love of the game from day one.
